haikus.haiku:
Layers intertwined,
Savory herbs fill the air,
A feast shared with joy.
Happy #NationalLasagnaDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Crimson kisses glow,
Soft whispers of sweet colors,
Laughter paints the day.
Happy #LipstickDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Candles flicker bright,
Laughter dances through the air,
Joyous hearts unite.
#HappyBirthdayWilliamWilberforce from @ClamBakeSanta

Silver glow above,
Whispers of the calm night breeze,
Hearts lift in delight.
Happy #FullMoon from @ClamBakeSanta
